title: "error while loading shared libraries: cannot open shared object file" in ROS 2 ros2 run: prebuilt .so files, sonames, install rules, RPATH and ldconfig, measured
excerpt: Why a node that builds fine fails under ros2 run with exit code 127: CMake strips the build RPATH on install. Measured fixes on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: installing every .so* file, $ORIGIN/.. RPATH, CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH, ldconfig, and install(TARGETS) for your own library.
